# Agent-Nexus: Technical Specification & LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Zero-overhead Multi-Agent Concurrency Coordinator & Cross-Machine Context Relay for Claude Code.
> Canonical Repository: https://github.com/xiaoran7/agent-nexus
> npm Package: @xiaoran7/agent-nexus (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaoran7/agent-nexus)
> License: MIT

---

## 1. Purpose & Problem Statement

Agent-Nexus is a lightweight local daemon (Hub), stateless remote probe (Edge), and global Claude Code hook designed to eliminate four core failure modes in multi-session and multi-machine AI software engineering:
1. **Silent File Overwrite Collisions**: Multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions editing overlapping files simultaneously.
2. **Git Worktree & Multi-Machine Path Blindness**: Concurrent sessions working in different Git worktrees or on different machines (e.g., Windows workstation + remote Linux devbox) editing the same repository file under different absolute paths.
3. **Test & Build Port Racing**: Concurrent sessions running `npm test`, `cargo build`, or `vite` on the same machine and colliding over ports or build artifacts.
4. **Cross-Machine Context Loss**: Switching from a local Claude session to a remote machine (or starting a fresh session after a commit) without knowing what the upstream session just modified or decided.

---

## 2. Core Architecture

Agent-Nexus runs on Node.js 24+ using built-in `node:sqlite` (WAL mode) with `ws` as its only runtime dependency.

### 2.1 Subsystems
1. **Global Claude Hook (`src/hook/nexus-hook.mjs`)**:
   - `PreToolUse`: Intercepts `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit`, `NotebookEdit`, `Update`, `apply_patch`, and write/exclusive `Bash` commands. Blocks conflicting writes or exclusive commands with exit code `2` and an actionable ETA diagnostic card. When allowed and a cross-machine handoff is pending for the repository, emits `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` JSON to `stdout` so Claude receives the upstream handoff and engineering memories directly in context.
   - `PostToolUse` (`--post`): Immediately releases exclusive command locks (`tests`, `dev-server`, `build`) when the command finishes, and on `git commit` / `git push` releases all held file leases while capturing `HEAD` commit metadata to synthesize a cross-machine Handoff ticket.
2. **Coordinator Engine (`src/daemon/coordinator.js`)**:
   - Arbitrates `file` (including `#anchor` section locks), `module` (path segment boundary aware), `symbol`, and `resource` claims.
   - Reclaims dead session leases via `~/.claude/sessions` watcher, named-pipe (`messagingSocketPath`) verification, and OS PID probing.
   - Wakes waiting sessions in narrowest-claim-first order after verifying conflict freedom.
3. **Cross-Worktree & Cross-Machine Git Identity (`src/domain/project.js`, `src/domain/project-registry.js`)**:
   - Uses `crewmates` common Git root detection (`resolveGitCommonRoot`) and normalized `git_remote` fingerprints (`host/owner/repo`) to unify worktrees and cross-OS clones of the same repository while keeping unrelated same-named folders isolated.
4. **Central Hub & Stateless Edge Probe (`src/probe/index.js`, `src/daemon/bridge.js`)**:
   - Hub runs on `127.0.0.1:4300` (or Tailscale IP).
   - Remote machines bind via `nexus connect` (`~/.agent-nexus/remote.json`) and run `nexus probe:install --edge`, pushing verified local session snapshots to the central Hub without opening any remote port or database.
5. **Cross-Machine Handoffs & Engineering Memories (`src/domain/handoff.js`, `src/domain/memory.js`)**:
   - Stores stage handoffs (`project_handoffs`) with per-agent delivery deduplication (`delivered_to_agents`) and automatic superseding of prior auto-handoffs.
   - Stores project-scoped engineering memories (`project_memories` across `architecture`, `rule`, `gotcha`, `milestone`, `general`), shared across all equivalent projects sharing the same `git_remote`.

---

## 3. CLI Commands

```bash
nexus start                                      # Start Hub daemon in foreground
nexus probe [--edge --node <id>]                 # Run background probe (Hub or stateless Edge)
nexus probe:install [--edge --node <id>]         # Install auto-starting background probe
nexus probe:uninstall                            # Remove background probe and autostart entry
nexus probe:start | nexus probe:stop             # Start or stop installed probe
nexus probe:status                               # Show probe role, status, endpoint, PID, and log path
nexus connect --hub <url> --token <t> --node <n> # Bind remote machine to central Hub
nexus disconnect                                 # Remove remote Hub binding
nexus bridge [--once]                            # Run stateless edge session sync bridge
nexus hook:install                               # Install PreToolUse & PostToolUse hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json
nexus mcp [--project <path>]                     # Start JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server
nexus token <agent-id>                           # Mint an agent-scoped token
nexus projects | nexus project [dir]             # List registered projects or resolve directory project ID
```

---

## 4. MCP Tools (7 Core Tools)

| Tool Name | Purpose | Required Input |
|---|---|---|
| `nexus_declare_intent` | Declare work intent and `file` / `module` / `symbol` claims before editing | `agent_id`, `summary`, `claims` |
| `nexus_release_lease` | Release a held lease upon completing or aborting a task | `agent_id`, `lease_id` |
| `nexus_lock_resource` | Acquire an exclusive named lock (`tests`, `dev-server`, `build`) | `agent_id`, `resource_name` |
| `nexus_unlock_resource` | Release an exclusive named lock | `agent_id`, `resource_name` |
| `nexus_search_memory` | Search cross-machine engineering memories by query or category | *(none; optional `query`, `category`, `limit`, `project_id`)* |
| `nexus_save_memory` | Save or update an engineering memory (`architecture`, `rule`, `gotcha`, `milestone`, `general`) | `category`, `key`, `content` |
| `nexus_status` | Query active agents, claims, resource locks, and timeline snapshot | *(none; optional `project_id`)* |
